blocks.x: Cyber & Zero-Trust applied to EdTech & Learning Platforms. This page sets out the operating context, the delivery pattern we run, the services and platforms involved, and the outcomes we commit to.

EdTech companies sell learning outcomes and must prove them: engagement-to-evidence loops, content ops at scale, assessment integrity and institutional procurement gates. Product velocity matters, but evidence velocity closes renewals.

items: SOC 2/ISO evidence manual per audit; deals stall.
Engagement metrics ≠ learning proof; renewals wobble.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Identity & Access Modernization, Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC, Threat Intelligence & Managed SOC from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Learning analytics, Content operations, Assessment integrity) on Dataq Sentinel and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — FERPA/COPPA/GDPR-K among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Secure at the control plane: posture, workload and data security engineered into the platform.
Secure the models themselves: prompt-injection defense, agent containment and AI red-teaming.
Assume breach, plan recovery: resilience engineered, rehearsed and measured.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Education & Research level this capability reads as: classification-aware controls for sensitive research programs (export-control posture evidenced). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

The engagement cadence below is the standard pattern for this capability. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
